description: Canonical review JSON contract. Shared by dev-review skill and dev-pipeline.

verdict.description: approve when no issues, request_changes when P0/P1 found, comment otherwise.

summary.description: Short prose summary of the review findings.

issues.description: List of review findings. Empty array for clean reviews.

severity.description: P0=Critical (immediate), P1=Critical (must fix), P2=Warning (should fix), P3=Suggestion (optional), info=Informational.

path.description: Relative file path where the issue was found. Omit if not file-specific.

line.description: Line number within path. Omit if not applicable.

suggested_fix.description: Optional code suggestion or fix description.
